heading: Claims not assignable or transferable; choice of remedies

tree.heading: Claims not assignable or transferable
tree.text: No claim cognizable under this subchapter shall be assignable or transferable.

tree.heading: Choice of remedies
tree.text: No individual may receive more than one payment of compensation under part B.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2004—Subsec. (a). Pub. L. 108–375 substituted “this subchapter” for “part B”.
